WITH THE NEW SEMI-OPERATIONAL C# PROGRAM, THE RECEIVED DATA CAN NOW BE READ FROM THE UART DEVICE. IT WAS DISCOVERED THAT MOST PACKETS SENT (INCLUDING HEADER) HAD A TOTAL LENGTH OF 90 BYTES, WHILE SOME ONLY HAD
	A TOTAL LENGTH OF 12 BYTES (INCLUDING HEADER) OR 42 BYTES. THESE ARE POSSIBLY INCOMPLETE PACKETS, MOST LIKELY A RESULT OF THE PROGRAM SAMPLING THE RECEPTION BUFFER TOO SLOWLY.
